Name: SOC 2 Type II (Trust Services Criteria) for Oracle Cloud (OCI)
Description: AICPA SOC 2 Type II evaluation covering Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, and Confidentiality controls across OCI Compartments, IAM, Networking, and Storage.

Requirements.Name: Logical Access and Identity Perimeter Controls
Requirements.Description: Ensure multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enforced for all IAM user accounts accessing OCI Console and privileged tenancy administration.

Requirements.Name: Credential Lifecycle and API Key Rotation
Requirements.Description: Ensure IAM user API signing keys, customer secret keys, and auth tokens are rotated every 90 days or less.

Requirements.Name: Principle of Least Privilege and Compartment Isolation
Requirements.Description: Ensure non-root compartments exist and tenancy administrative privileges are strictly scoped to specific compartments.

Requirements.Name: Network Boundary Protection & Ingress Filtering
Requirements.Description: Ensure Security Lists and Network Security Groups do not allow unrestricted ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to administrative ports (SSH 22, RDP 3389).

Requirements.Name: Data Transmission Encryption & In-Transit Protection
Requirements.Description: Ensure in-transit encryption is enabled for OCI compute instances and secure boot is enforced.

Requirements.Name: Data-at-Rest Protection with Customer-Managed Keys (KMS)
Requirements.Description: Ensure Block Volumes, Boot Volumes, File Systems, and Object Storage Buckets are encrypted with Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) and KMS keys are rotated.

Requirements.Name: Cloud Threat Detection & Security Monitoring with Cloud Guard
Requirements.Description: Ensure Oracle Cloud Guard is enabled and actively monitoring the tenancy for configuration drift and security problems.

Requirements.Name: Audit Logging and Security Event Alerting
Requirements.Description: Ensure OCI Audit log retention is configured for 365 days and event rules are active for IAM policy, network, and security list modifications.

Requirements.Name: Object Storage Public Access Restriction & Versioning
Requirements.Description: Ensure Object Storage buckets are not publicly accessible, logging is enabled, and object versioning is turned on for business resilience.

Requirements.Name: Database & Analytics Instance Access Restriction
Requirements.Description: Ensure Autonomous Databases and Oracle Analytics Cloud instances are restricted to authorized VCNs or private IP ranges.
